title: DevBench — Inspect · System
subtitle: AmigaOS 4.1 on QEMU sam460ex · profile qemu-os4 · :3000

items.label: System info
items.text: Free chip / fast RAM, bridge client count, the task list and the loaded libraries in one view (MCP: amiga_sysinfo).

items.label: Bridge info
items.text: Daemon version and uptime (MCP: amiga_version / amiga_uptime).

items.label: Volumes
items.text: Mounted volumes with size and free space (MCP: amiga_list_volumes).

items.label: Intuition inspector
items.text: Screens → windows → gadgets, with front/back/move/size actions (MCP: amiga_list_screens / amiga_list_screen_windows / amiga_list_gadgets).

items.label: Input injection
items.text: Send key presses and mouse moves/clicks through input.device (MCP: amiga_input_key / amiga_input_click).

items.label: Library / device inspector
items.text: Loaded libraries or devices with version and open count; click for details (MCP: amiga_list_libs / amiga_lib_info).

items.label: Assign manager
items.text: Logical assigns and their targets; add or change them (MCP: amiga_list_assigns / amiga_assign).

items.label: Fonts, locale, ARexx, clipboard
items.text: Font and catalog browsers, ARexx port list + command sender, clipboard get/set (MCP: amiga_arexx_ports / amiga_arexx_send).

items.label: Files & boot
items.text: Startup-sequence editor, ENV: prefs, boot log, live file tail, checksum and protection bits (MCP: amiga_tail / amiga_checksum / amiga_protect).
